topic: verifying SLSA provenance on tag-built images - the standing checklist for confirming that provenance attestations match the tag, digest, and builder expectations

subtopics.scope: Why verification anchors on the immutable digest rather than the movable tag, and how to resolve a handed tag reference to its exact digest before any check runs.
seed_queries: docker registry tag digest immutability tag mutation attack
resolve docker image tag to digest registry API skopeo inspect

subtopics.scope: Enumerating the attestations attached to a container image in the registry: cosign fetch-attestations, the OCI referrers/attestation-manifest layout, and confirming a SLSA provenance attestation actually exists.
seed_queries: cosign fetch-attestations list image attestations registry
OCI image referrers API attestation manifest SLSA provenance storage

subtopics.scope: Verifying the attestation signature itself with cosign verify-attestation against the expected signer identity, including keyless Sigstore identity checks and treating unsigned or foreign-signed attestations as a hard fail.
seed_queries: cosign verify-attestation keyless identity verification guide
sigstore fulcio rekor cosign verify attestation identity regex

subtopics.scope: Reading the SLSA provenance predicate body (buildDefinition, externalParameters, resolvedDependencies) and checking that recorded build inputs match the claim: pinned base image digest and source ref.
seed_queries: SLSA provenance predicate v1 buildDefinition resolvedDependencies fields
verify provenance predicate build inputs base image digest source ref

subtopics.scope: Checking that the predicate's builder identity matches the expected builder (GitHub Actions SLSA generator builder.id, reusable workflow, buildType) and what a builder mismatch means.
seed_queries: verify builder identity SLSA provenance buildType github runner

subtopics.scope: Running slsa-verifier verify-image as the independent second check: source-uri, source-tag, expected-builder-id flags, and interpreting its failure modes.
seed_queries: slsa-verifier verify-image source-tag expected builder id usage

subtopics.scope: Semantics specific to tag-built images: how source-tag matching in provenance differs from main-branch builds, tag-based verification limits, and when a tag-built artifact needs digest-level matching instead.
seed_queries: slsa-github-generator tag build provenance source-tag verification
github actions release tag workflow SLSA provenance source-tag

subtopics.scope: Checklist discipline on failure: any failed step is a stop, failed artifacts are quarantined from bump and policy decisions, tool version skew checks before tampering conclusions, and recording verification evidence (digest, attestation digest, verifier, date).
seed_queries: supply chain policy quarantine failed provenance verification artifact
software supply chain verification evidence record digest attestation audit
